name: claude-code-self-tools
description: Small Claude Code plugins that let a session act on itself: compact, reload its plugins, read its context window, switch its effort or model, wake itself later, and turn on Remote Control. Install only the ones you want.

plugins.name: self-compact
plugins.description: Compacts the conversation once the turn ends, at the break between two pieces of work, then resumes on its own.

plugins.name: self-reload
plugins.description: Reloads the session's plugins once the turn ends, as /reload-plugins does, then resumes on its own.

plugins.name: self-context
plugins.description: Reads how full the context window is, and whether auto-compact is on, to decide whether to compact at a break.

plugins.name: self-config
plugins.description: Switches the session's effort level and model, and nothing else, as the turn ends, announced from the old value to the new.

plugins.name: self-wake
plugins.description: Wakes the session some minutes after the turn ends with a note it sends itself, to check back on slow work.

plugins.name: self-remote-control
plugins.description: Reports on the session's Remote Control and connects it, never toggling a live connection off.
